h1: Accept crypto payments for VPN & privacy software without chargebacks
subheading: Stop losing revenue to payment fraud and involuntary churn. Dynopay delivers Bitcoin, stablecoins, and 15+ cryptocurrencies directly to your wallet.
intro_paragraph: VPN and privacy software providers face constant payment friction: card declines from security flags, chargeback fraud from users who consumed bandwidth then disputed charges, and involuntary churn when banks flag recurring payments as suspicious. Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto commerce platform that deposits every payment directly into your wallet—no intermediary custody, no chargeback risk, no frozen funds. Support Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT across three chains, and 15+ total cryptocurrencies with fees starting at 1.5% that drop to 0.5% as you scale.

features.title: Zero chargeback risk, ever
features.description: Crypto payments are final. Users who abuse your bandwidth can't reverse the transaction six months later. You keep every dollar you earn from legitimate subscribers without fraud liability.

features.title: Non-custodial: funds hit your wallet
features.description: Every payment settles directly to your Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoin wallet. Dynopay never holds your money, so you control liquidity and eliminate counterparty risk from payment processors.

features.title: Cut involuntary churn from card declines
features.description: Card networks flag VPN subscriptions as high-risk, causing false declines. Crypto payments bypass legacy rails entirely, so privacy-conscious users renew without friction and you retain more revenue.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, and add the wallet address where you want to receive payments.
Generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget on your subscription page in under 10 minutes.
Customers pay in Bitcoin, USDT, Ethereum, or 15+ cryptos; funds arrive directly in your wallet within minutes.

faqs.question: Why do VPN companies accept cryptocurrency payments?
faqs.answer: Crypto eliminates chargebacks, reduces involuntary churn from card declines, and appeals to privacy-focused users who prefer not to link bank accounts. Dynopay supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on three chains, and 15+ total cryptocurrencies with non-custodial settlement directly to your wallet.

faqs.question: How much does Dynopay charge for crypto payments?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drop automatically to 0.5% as your volume grows. Your first payment is completely free. No monthly fees, no setup costs, no hidden charges, and no chargeback fees because chargebacks don't exist in crypto.

faqs.question: Can users subscribe monthly with cryptocurrency?
faqs.answer: Yes, cycle by cycle. Crypto has no card-style auto-charge, so each renewal is a fresh payment: send subscribers a payment link per billing cycle, or automate it with the REST API and webhooks. Renewals never fail on issuer declines or expired cards, so involuntary churn stays lower than card-based plans.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can my VPN accept?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports Bitcoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin, Ethereum with USDT and USDC, Polygon, Tron with USDT, Solana, and XRP Ledger including RLUSD. That's 15+ cryptocurrencies total, and every payment deposits directly into the wallet you control—never held by Dynopay.

faqs.question: How fast can I start accepting crypto for my VPN service?
faqs.answer: Under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, create your company profile, add one payout wallet address, then generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget. You're live immediately with no technical integration required, though REST API and webhooks are available for developers.
